_about: Registry of every tool the creative hub drives. scripts/hub.ps1 reads this file. `requires` lists ids that `hub.ps1 start` starts first. To add a tool: add one entry here, one server in .mcp.json, and a line in README.md. `lock` (optional) is the app's engine lock file under `data`; `hub.ps1 stop` deletes it after the kill when its pid is no longer running. `hub.ps1 start` also deletes it before starting the app when its pid is gone or the process with that pid started after the lock's time (pid reuse). VN Studio also reads this file to start pixel-studio, chiptune-studio and comfyui when a job needs them: keep their fields (id, repo, port, mcp, http, managed, warning, startTimeout, start {kind, path, cwd, args, env}); kinds other than electron and exe are ignored for these three.

services.name: Scriptorium (book writer)
services.warning: Starting the engine resumes the book factory: it starts writing every open idea in ~/Scriptorium/ideas, user ideas first, and may use paid models (budget in config/budget.md).

services.name: Book Translator
services.auth: Bearer token from the user env var BOOK_TRANSLATOR_MCP_TOKEN (hub.ps1 setup creates it).

services.name: Chiptune Studio (MIDI / chiptune music)
dataFiles: ~\ChiptuneStudio\soundfonts\GeneralUser-GS.sf2: the gm chip's SoundFont (GeneralUser GS v2.0.3, https://github.com/mrbumpy409/GeneralUser-GS; not in the repo or installer; soundfont_status checks it)

services.name: VibeTTS (Kokoro / Supertonic speech)
services.note: Tray app that autostarts at login. MCP needs [mcp] enabled = true in D:\Programs\VibeTTS\config.toml (Settings > Agents (MCP)).

services.name: ComfyUI (images, music, TTS models)
services.note: Plain HTTP API, no MCP of its own: comfy-mcp (next entry) is its MCP server, and VN Studio calls the API directly. The hub starts the server headless with the same command Comfy Desktop uses (from its app.log); for the graph editor open http://127.0.0.1:8188 or use Comfy Desktop (which then moves to 8199 if the hub's server is up).

services.name: ComfyUI MCP (images, edits, cutouts, music, speech, saved workflows)
services.note: Generates through the comfyui service (8188); it starts without it, and its status tool says when ComfyUI is down. Outputs default to the data folder; every tool takes an absolute out path.

services.name: LM Studio (not used by the hub any more; not installed)
services.note: Not used any more (HUB-38): every app reaches local LLMs, and Scriptorium its nomic embeddings (`acp/llama/nomic-embed-text-v1.5`, AAP-43), through acp-proxy. LM Studio is not installed on this PC. The VN and Edu art-critic and the Cartoon frame-critic use `acp/llama/inkling-2-mini` through acp-proxy (HUB-39); Pixel Studio has no local vision model (HUB-41: Inkling's context is too small for its artist prompt). The entry stays so hub.ps1 status shows the port.

services.name: Strata (local LLM server, one model at a time)
services.note: The ACP proxy starts Strata itself on an `acp/strata/*` request (providers.strata.command in its settings.json). Start it by hand only to diagnose (scripts/strata-probe.mjs) and only when the proxy has no local model loaded: a hand-started Strata is passed through but never stopped by the proxy, so a gufo or llama request would load a second model beside it.

services.name: ACP Proxy (one OpenAI-compatible API for every model: the Codex, Antigravity and Claude agents and the local Gufo, Strata and Llama.cpp models)
services.note: Provider `acp` (base_url http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1, json_schema false) of all seven apps; their only route to LLMs, local ones included (HUB-38). The desktop app (run from the repo, tray, `--hidden`) is the only build that starts and switches the local servers (Gufo 8081, Strata 8080 with `D:\Strata\terminal\run-unsloth-ud-iq4_xs-parallel.bat`, Llama.cpp 8082): one local model on the GPU at a time, a switch takes minutes, the request waits. Caps, timeout (900000), body size, `listBareAliases: false`, per-provider `maxConcurrent` (codex 4, antigravity 3, claude 2, strata 4, gufo 1, llama 1) are in `%APPDATA%\api-acp-proxy\settings.json` or its Server page, never in env here. The headless `node dist/index.js` cannot start local models. Local models: no tools, `response_format` is prompt-only, `reasoning_effort` passes (AAP-42), embeddings `llama/nomic-embed-text-v1.5` (AAP-43). Antigravity through it breaks clause 6 of Antigravity's terms: the user accepted that risk (2026-10-22).

services.name: flow-music-mcp (Google Flow and Flow Music: images, video, characters, voices, songs, assembly, captions)
services.note: One MCP for both Google sites (replaces flow-mcp, retired 2026-10-22: Flow was redesigned). Own Chrome profile (~/.flow-music-mcp/chrome-profile, CDP 9334) with a tab per site, opened on the first tool call; sign in once with yarn login. Free: Flow images, Gemini and Windows voices, assembly, captions (own whisper.cpp, installed on first use). Credits: Flow video and Flow voices (max_credits), Flow Music songs. Keys and settings: .env in the repo or ~/.flow-music-mcp/.env (see .env.example). ElevenLabs (FMM-17/18, HUB-31): flow_narrate engine elevenlabs with word timestamps, flow_elevenlabs_status and flow_elevenlabs_voices; free tier only (refuses past the remaining credits minus a 200 reserve and any non-free tier). The user alone sets the key in ELEVENLABS_API_KEY or ELEVEN_CREATOR_KEY (environment) or ~/.flow-music-mcp/.env; hub.ps1 start passes a user-scope key to this service only and prints only set / not set. No tool sets the key.
